statement: GRACE introduces a reflective feedback loop (RFL) that feeds rejection back into retrieval and revises subsequent retrieval based on failure types, providing an adaptive repair mechanism for KGQA.

evidence.quote: We introduce GRACE (Graph Reasoning with Adaptive Controller and Evidence), which feeds rejection back into retrieval and restores accept–reject symmetry in the search. GRACE assigns a failure type to each rejected path. Its reflective feedback loop (RFL) revises subsequent retrieval, whereas hypothetical bridging (HB) admits budgeted and penalized virtual edges for plausible missing links.
